about: Which families the Steady Hands bench is built from as real art. integration owns the contents; AssemblyBenchInstall20261120 (prefab, sight, verify) and SteadyHandsBenchInstall20261120 read it. "real" = Assets/AthenHill/Art/Bench/<Family>/<family>.glb with <family>.parts.json beside it; "greybox" (or not named) = the stand-in family. What a real family's model lacks is filled with stand-ins of the same ids by the builder.
